assumptions.observation_assumptions: Raw 4096-count encoder plus the recorded bw=6 observer. 3 ms telemetry and 1 ms command delays are declared engineering assumptions, not identified latency distributions. No extra Gaussian noise beyond quantization and no dropout in this baseline; stress these assumptions before hardware use.
assumptions.rationale: Development training: use measured rail and recorded executor snapshot; .35 kg cart, .02275 kg equivalent pole mass, .05 N s/m cart damping and 20 N force ceiling remain explicit assumptions. Replace passive length/damping/friction using the frozen batch-6 candidate. No claim of measured force authority, actuator tracking, global encoder mapping or hardware transfer.
